loc-1766135795180-1yakuhbry.name: The Moon

dna.looks: AERIAL/SATELLITE VIEW: vast, cratered lunar surface stretching to the horizon, Earth visible as a distant celestial body, no individual structures visible.
dna.colorsAndLighting: Harsh, direct sunlight casting deep shadows, with the blackness of space dominating. Earth provides a soft, blue and white glow.
dna.atmosphere: Utter vacuum. No air, no weather. The sky is a perpetual, inky black.
dna.materials: Dominant material is fine, grey lunar regolith. Occasional darker volcanic rock.
dna.mood: Profound isolation, stark beauty, silent desolation, cosmic wonder.
dna.sounds: Complete silence. The absence of atmosphere means no sound transmission.
dna.secondary_surfaces: Impact crater rims and ejecta blankets.
dna.accent_features: Earth as a prominent, colored celestial object.

loc-1766135795180-1yakuhbry.description: The Moon is a desolate and cratered landscape under a star-filled sky. Its surface is a stark expanse of grey regolith, punctuated by ancient impact craters. Distant Earth hangs as a vibrant blue marble in the black void.
loc-1766135795180-1yakuhbry.searchDesc: Desolate lunar surface, cratered landscape, star-filled sky, distant Earth.

structure.spatialLayout: Vast, unbroken plains interrupted by impact craters of varying sizes. A gentle curvature to the horizon.

location-1766141209791-t208sv0yp.name: The Alien Temple

dna.looks: A vast, cavernous chamber with smoothly curved, organic walls that seem to absorb light. The ceiling arches upwards into darkness, hinting at immense scale. Strange, faint geometric patterns pulse softly on the surfaces.
dna.colorsAndLighting: Dominated by deep, light-absorbing blacks and the subtle, internal glow of faint, shifting bioluminescent veins within the walls. The only external light source is the dim, diffused glow from the passage leading to the lunar surface, casting long, indistinct shadows.
dna.atmosphere: Utter vacuum. A profound, tomb-like silence broken only by an almost imperceptible, low-frequency hum. The temperature is absolute zero, the air non-existent.
dna.materials: Polished obsidian-like material forming the primary structure, interlaced with veins of softly glowing, unknown bioluminescent organic matter. The floor is a continuation of the polished, seamless material.
dna.mood: Awe-inspiring, unsettling, ancient, profound, sacred dread.
dna.sounds: Subtle hum, low resonating thrum, echoing silence.
dna.spatialLayout: Vast, domed cavern with a seamless, flowing interior.
dna.accent_features: Pulsing geometric patterns, central archway to exterior
dna.secondary: Subtle, shifting internal glow (e.g., deep violet or cyan)

location-1766141209791-t208sv0yp.description: The alien temple hangs in the blackness, a stark silhouette against the distant, cratered surface of the moon. Its monolithic, organic form is a deep, light-absorbing black, broken only by minimal, glowing arched openings. Ethereal light emanates from within, hinting at the mysteries it holds.

structure.spatialLayout: A monolithic, organic temple structure floats in the void of space near the dark side of the moon. Its surfaces absorb light, creating an unsettling presence.

navigableElements.description: Leads out to the lunar surface, offering a stark view of the cratered plains and distant Earth.
Descends into the inner sanctums of the alien temple.

niche-1766145503667-q6cf2pt3q.description: The interior of the Alien Ship envelops you in a sense of immense, organic scale. The walls are clad in smooth, seamless composite panels that reflect a faint, shifting iridescence. The floor is a sturdy, worn metal grate, through which a low, persistent hum seems to emanate, creating a subtly claustrophobic atmosphere. Above, a dimly lit canopy diffuses an unsettling, otherworldly glow. The curving, flowing nature of the ship's structure is evident in every line and surface, guiding your movement through its vast, alien interior.

structure.spatialLayout: The interior of the Alien Ship is a vast, organically curving space. Its layout feels less constructed and more grown, with smooth, flowing lines directing movement through its immense volume. The overall impression is one of alien, almost biological, architecture.
